note: Kentucky State Parks campground on the wooded bluff above the Mississippi River at Columbus, beside the Civil War earthworks; back-in sites, full hookups at 24-33. Two camping trailers and a camping cabin rent by phone. Museum, mini golf and snack bar in season; 2.5-mile trail. --Claude
